summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing modification of its equity line of credit with Ascent Partners Fund LLC. The company submitted an Advance Notice requesting share purchases under the securities purchase agreement dated July 28, 2025 (amended December 22, 2025). For notices from June 8 to July 15, 2026, maximum draw is 9.99% of outstanding shares capped at $200,000 per notice. Purchase price equals 97% of lowest 10-day VWAP, funded upon share delivery. A true-up mechanism adjusts shares if resale proceeds are below closing price. Ascent waived mandatory prepayment. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation. Watch for dilution from continued draws under the equity line.
